scope: In-process WinUI RenderTargetBitmap content after two rendering frames only. Composition-backed effects/surfaces, transparency, theme transitions and selection visuals may be omitted or differ from the displayed window; capture anomalies require independent live-window verification before being classified as UI defects. Excludes window chrome, other apps, desktop, popups outside this tree, Narrator and OS appearance/scaling acceptance. A PNG is visual review material, not C24/C25 acceptance.
